name: A quick code review says 'review'
case: You ask the agent to look over a pull request, and it finishes within a minute with its findings. Boop gives a small face, played as a success or a reply, and mumbles 'review'.
why: harness/DECISIONS.md §3: 'review' is a review of code or a pull request, as your prompt or the agent's last message says; a review's findings are work done or an answer, so a success or a reply

steps.prompt: can you review PR 214 before I merge it

steps.message: I read through the PR. One nit: the new helper has no test. The rest looks good to merge.
